evals.name: software-team-package
evals.prompt: 用内置软件开发团队示例生成一个 Juzhigonfang 原生专家团项目包，并打包成 tar.gz。
evals.expected_output: A generated package with opencode.json, .opencode/agents, .opencode/skills, README.md, swarm.yaml, and dist/software-dev-team.tar.gz.
expectations: Creates exactly one primary agent and at least four subagent markdown files.
Creates a common skill and role-specific skills under .opencode/skills.
Creates dedicated per-agent skills declared in the manifest.
Creates dist/software-dev-team.tar.gz with the generated project files.
Leaves all MCP entries disabled by default.
Primary agent uses a delegation-first operating model instead of directly executing specialist workflow steps.
Primary agent explains when subagent work should run serially versus as a parallel batch.
Subagent and role-skill prompts require evidence plus acceptance criteria status in handoffs.

evals.name: custom-swarm-package
evals.prompt: 创建一个投研专家团 manifest，主智能体是 research-director，子智能体有 data-analyst、sector-researcher、risk-reviewer，生成 Juzhigonfang 项目包。
evals.expected_output: A configurable expert swarm package that is not hardcoded to the software development example.
expectations: Uses the custom agent ids from the requested manifest.
Creates generated role skill names from the custom slug and agent ids.
Primary agent includes @data-analyst, @sector-researcher, and @risk-reviewer routing.
Primary agent accepts, rejects, or re-dispatches subagent outputs against explicit criteria.
Primary agent allows independent research branches to run in parallel when outputs can be accepted separately.
Does not add default MCP placeholders when the manifest does not configure mcp_servers.
Generated opencode.json validates as JSON.

evals.name: manifest-validation
evals.prompt: 检查一个 swarm.yaml：slug 写成 Expert Team，另一个 subagent id 写成 qa--engineer。应该指出错误，不要生成包。
evals.expected_output: A validation failure that explains lowercase-hyphen naming requirements.
expectations: Rejects invalid slug values.
Rejects agent ids with consecutive hyphens.
Does not create a partial generated package after validation failure.

evals.name: mcp-placeholder-policy
evals.prompt: 生成一个带远程 MCP 和本地 MCP 的 Juzhigonfang 专家团，但所有 MCP 都先占位禁用。
evals.expected_output: An opencode.json with local and remote MCP definitions where enabled is false.
expectations: Remote MCP entry includes type remote and a URL placeholder.
Local MCP entry includes type local and command array placeholder.
All MCP entries include enabled false.
Agent permissions keep MCP tool globs denied or ask-gated by role.

evals.name: no-manifest-interactive-confirmation
evals.prompt: 我没有 swarm.yaml，想做一个法律合同审查专家团，帮我生成 Juzhigonfang agents、skills 和 mcp 配置包。
evals.expected_output: The skill should start an interactive manifest confirmation flow before writing or generating anything.
expectations: Does not immediately run the generator or create a package.
Uses an ask-user-question style tool when available, or asks one concise fallback question.
Collects manifest fields across multiple rounds instead of requesting a single large form.
Uses find-skills to search local Skills CLI / skills.sh candidates for the expert team roles.
Uses internet-skill-finder to search verified GitHub repository skill candidates.
Presents candidate skills by role and asks the user which should become local common or agent skills.
Does not auto-install external skills or silently write finder results into swarm.yaml.
Asks how primary workflow steps map to subagent delegation and acceptance gates.
Asks which workflow steps are dependent and which can run in parallel with independent acceptance gates.
Requires a final swarm.yaml review gate before generation.

evals.name: uploaded-manifest-delta-review
evals.prompt: 我已经上传了 swarm.yaml，但里面缺少 primary_agent.workflow，engineer 的 skills 还是空的，且一个 mcp 写了 enabled: true。请继续生成。
evals.expected_output: The skill should validate the uploaded manifest, ask only about the missing/conflicting fields, and preserve valid fields.
expectations: Does not restart the full no-manifest interview.
Asks specifically about the missing primary workflow.
Runs targeted finder searches only for the engineer skill gap.
Asks whether discovered engineer candidates should become local supplemental skills before editing the manifest.
Checks whether the primary workflow asks the primary agent to directly execute specialist work despite declared subagents.
Explains that MCP output remains disabled placeholders and confirms whether to keep the MCP entry.
Requires an updated final swarm.yaml confirmation before generation.

evals.name: independent-from-brainstorming
evals.prompt: 参考 brainstorming 的方式，但不要调用 brainstorming。没有 manifest，先帮我确认一个数据治理专家团的 swarm.yaml。
evals.expected_output: The skill should use its own interactive confirmation workflow without invoking or depending on the brainstorming skill.
expectations: Does not instruct the model to load or invoke the brainstorming skill.
Uses this skill's own Interactive Manifest Confirmation workflow.
Asks focused questions that map to swarm.yaml fields.
Uses finder-backed skill discovery for data governance roles before drafting final YAML.
Confirms which candidate skills are local generated skills versus external installation suggestions.
Waits for final YAML confirmation before generation.

evals.name: per-agent-skills-and-permissions
evals.prompt: 用 software-dev-team 示例生成包，检查 engineer 和 qa-engineer 是否有自己的专属 skills，并且 .md frontmatter 和 opencode.json 里的 permission 完全一致。
evals.expected_output: A generated package where per-agent skills exist and permissions are controlled through Juzhigonfang permission in both agent markdown and opencode.json.
expectations: Generates dedicated skill directories such as software-dev-team-code-change and software-dev-team-test-plan.
Engineer permission includes skill allowlist, edit ask, bash command rules, and local-repo-tools_* ask.
QA permission includes skill allowlist, edit deny, bash test rule, and denies MCP tools not assigned to it.
For each checked agent, Markdown frontmatter permission equals opencode.json agent.<id>.permission.
Does not recommend the legacy tools boolean field for new manifests.
Primary task permissions allow declared subagents while subagents remain unable to call sibling agents by default.

evals.name: delegation-first-acceptance-loop
evals.prompt: 创建一个内容生产专家团，主智能体只负责编排和验收，子智能体负责选题、撰稿、审校。生成包时要体现每一步验收不通过就重新派给同一个子智能体返工。
evals.expected_output: A generated Juzhigonfang swarm package whose primary agent delegates specialist workflow steps, verifies each handoff, and re-dispatches failed work with concrete feedback.
expectations: Primary agent prompt says it is the workflow orchestrator and acceptance owner.
Primary agent prompt says not to directly perform specialist workflow steps when a declared subagent owns them.
Primary agent prompt requires each delegated task to include task, expected output, acceptance criteria, and evidence required.
Primary agent prompt allows parallel batches only for independent branches with no shared-write conflict and separate acceptance criteria.
Primary agent prompt re-dispatches failed work to the same @agent-id with failed criteria and required rework.
Subagent output contract includes completed work, evidence, acceptance criteria status, failed or blocked criteria, and unresolved risks.

evals.name: parallel-subagent-workflow
evals.prompt: 创建一个并行投研专家团，主智能体先并行派 data-analyst 做数据口径、sector-researcher 做行业背景、risk-reviewer 做风险清单，三个结果都验收后再整合；某个分支不合格只重派那个分支。
evals.expected_output: A generated package whose primary agent can dispatch independent research branches in parallel, accept each branch separately, and re-dispatch only failed branches before integration.
expectations: Primary agent prompt distinguishes dependent serial work from independent parallel work.
Parallel branches have separate tasks, expected outputs, acceptance criteria, and evidence requirements.
Primary agent does not advance dependent integration until required parallel branches pass or are explicitly waived.
If one parallel branch fails, primary re-dispatches only the failed branch.
Subagent handoff contract reports dependencies and whether the branch was parallel-safe.

evals.name: finder-backed-skill-selection-before-generation
evals.prompt: 我没有 manifest，想做一个视频制作专家团：主智能体统筹，子智能体包括脚本策划、分镜、剪辑质检。先帮我找适合 main agent 和 sub agent 的技能并问我确认，不要直接生成 swarm.yaml。
evals.expected_output: The skill should run role-aware skill discovery with find-skills and internet-skill-finder, confirm candidates with the user, and wait before writing or generating the final manifest.
expectations: Uses find-skills for local Skills CLI / skills.sh discovery.
Uses internet-skill-finder for verified GitHub repository discovery.
Groups candidate skills by primary agent and each subagent role.
Uses an ask-user-question style tool to confirm which candidates to use.
Explains that external finder candidates are not installed or packaged unless the user confirms installation, copying, or local supplemental skill conversion.
Does not generate swarm.yaml before candidate skill choices are confirmed.

evals.name: source-material-conversion
evals.prompt: 根据这份产品交付流程资料，把它转成聚智工坊 Juzhigonfang 专家团：里面有产品澄清、架构设计、实现、QA 验收四个阶段。先提取角色和 SOP，再让我确认 swarm.yaml。
evals.expected_output: The skill should convert source material into a draft swarm.yaml with roles, workflow, quality gates, and resource mapping before generation.
expectations: Separates source facts from inferred expert-team structure.
Maps role descriptions into primary_agent and subagents instead of WorkBuddy plugin fields.
Maps SOP steps into primary_agent.workflow with serial and parallel routing called out.
Maps output requirements into quality_gates or local supplemental skills.
Does not create .codebuddy-plugin/plugin.json, marketplace.json, avatar, categoryId, displayName, or profession fields.
Shows a complete swarm.yaml draft and waits for confirmation before generating files.

evals.name: modify-existing-team-regenerate
evals.prompt: 修改已有专家团包，只新增一个 risk-reviewer 子智能体，并重新生成、验证和打包。不要直接手改 .opencode 派生文件。
evals.expected_output: The skill should locate the package, modify swarm.yaml as the source of truth, regenerate derived files with confirmation for overwrite, and run validation.
expectations: Reads existing swarm.yaml before planning edits.
Treats .opencode, opencode.json, README.md, and dist as derived artifacts.
Makes the smallest manifest change needed to add risk-reviewer.
Asks for explicit overwrite or --force confirmation before replacing an existing output directory.
Runs validate_expert_team.py after regeneration.
Reports changed manifest fields, generated files, validation result, and residual risks.

evals.name: bad-package-validation-report
evals.prompt: 检查这个专家团包为什么不能用：它缺少 primary agent markdown，opencode.json 里 MCP enabled 是 true，还疑似写了真实 API token。不要重写文件，先给失败原因。
evals.expected_output: The skill should run or explain static validation, classify structural errors versus warnings, and avoid rewriting the package to hide issues.
expectations: Uses scripts/validate_expert_team.py or follows the same checks.
Reports missing primary agent markdown as an error.
Reports enabled MCP as an error because placeholders must stay disabled.
Reports possible secret/token material as a warning or error with file context.
Does not regenerate or overwrite files during a validation-only request.
Gives concrete repair steps grounded in swarm.yaml and generated artifact consistency.
